gloss: as scheduled; as planned; on schedule

definitions.gloss: as scheduled; as planned; on schedule
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something proceeds exactly according to the original plan or schedule, without changes or delays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予定通|よていどお}り⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予定通|よていどお}り⟦{進|すす}んでいます→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The construction is progressing on schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予定通|よていどお}り⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The weather was bad, but the sports festival was held as planned.

notes:
USAGE:
{予定通|よていどお}り can function as an adverb modifying a verb, or as a noun with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. It is one of the most common ～{通|どお}り expressions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ～{通|どお}り pattern attaches to nouns to mean "as (noun)." Other common examples: {計画通|けいかくどお}り (as planned), ⟦{期待通|きたいどお}り→期待通り：15320_kitaidoori⟧ (as expected), {説明通|せつめいどお}り (as explained).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予定通|よていどお}り⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to proceed on schedule)
- {予定通|よていどお}り⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧ (to hold as scheduled)
- {予定通|よていどお}り⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to arrive on time)
